planned_by: Claude (Critic): owner request — per-round missions, public runs with a daily limit
goal:
T84 — owner: "라운드별로 미션 다르게 지정할수있게" and "anyone may try it for fun, with a daily limit". API only.
1. POST /v1/arena/prompt takes optional "rounds": list of missions for round 2, 3, ... (at most 4, each 1..2000 chars
   after strip; otherwise 422 and nothing starts). The ONE started job runs round 1 (run_prompt_arena) and then each next
   mission as a follow-up of the previous round (seed_running + run_followup_arena with parent_id = previous round,
   root_id = round 1, round_index 2, 3, ...; ids may be derived from the root id), so GET /v1/arena/{root}/chain shows
   R1..Rn with their own prompts and each lane continues from its own code. The root document carries
   "plan": [round 1 prompt, round 2 mission, ...] in its final save (stored arena documents are immutable in PostgreSQL
   mode: pass it into run_prompt_arena, do not re-save). Stop the plan after a failed round.
2. Daily public limit: EVO_PUBLIC_DAILY_RUNS (default 20). A run = one round (root, follow-up or sealed Arena start).
   used_today = Arena documents created today (UTC) + rounds a running plan has reserved but not started yet. A start
   that would exceed the limit (a plan needs 1 + len(rounds)) -> 429 "daily run limit reached", nothing starts. Apply it
   to POST /v1/arena/prompt, POST /v1/arena/{id}/followup and POST /v1/arena. GET /v1/arena/limits ->
   {"daily_limit", "used_today", "remaining"}; allow it through the web proxy (lib/proxyPolicy.ts + cases).
Keep every existing Arena test green. Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t84.py.
